A very well-stocked pet shop with professional and friendly service
Wonderful shop, very good products for both dogs and cats, and very kind staff. Since I'm just missing your calendar, I wanted to know when it will arrive.

I've only been coming here since they opened: the prices are market-level, and while they're certainly not competitive with online purchases, there's also the unfair competition, which, for a few euros, shouldn't, in my opinion, be encouraged. In any case, you always have to keep an eye out for offers
and promotions. The kindness, the affability that never leaves room for intrusiveness, the helpfulness and expertise of the staff are an added value that shouldn't be overlooked. I will never change. Thank you all. Loredana
